title: The Four-Quadrant Coordinate Plane
topic: Plotting and identifying points in all four quadrants

items.prompt: The point (3, -4) is located in which quadrant?
items.rationale: Positive x, negative y places a point in Quadrant IV.

items.prompt: The point (-2, 5) is located in which quadrant?
items.rationale: Negative x, positive y places a point in Quadrant II.

items.prompt: What are the coordinates of the origin?
items.rationale: The origin is where the x-axis and y-axis cross, at (0, 0).

items.prompt: A point with a negative x-coordinate and a negative y-coordinate is located in:
items.rationale: Negative x, negative y places a point in Quadrant III.

items.prompt: Point A is at (2, 3) and Point B is at (2, -3). Since they share the same x-coordinate, what is the vertical distance between them?
